reason: Both identify the same core defects (LEFT JOIN turned INNER, UTC vs UTC+8 boundary, integer division truncation, NULL total/sort issues) with equally correct fixes, but Response A cleanly separates the NULL-total and NULL-sort-order problems into distinct, precisely stated defects, while Response B tacks on an inaccurate aside ('The same misalignment applies to any other day boundary in the range') that doesn't apply since the query has only a single one-sided date filter, not a multi-boundary range.
